display_duration.description: Seconds per turn on the panel while a print is active

printer_prefix.description: The printer's entity prefix: sensor.<prefix>_print_status etc. (from the Bambu Lab integration)

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between polls while a print is active

idle_poll_seconds.description: Seconds between polls while the printer is idle

interrupt.description: Take over the panel when a print finishes, fails or pauses

finished_hold_minutes.description: How long the PRINT DONE card stays in the rotation after a print finishes

show_idle.description: Show a PRINTER IDLE card instead of skipping the plugin when nothing is printing

show_cover.description: Use the printer's cover image as the thumbnail

test_mode.description: Play a made-up print job through every screen (no printer polling). Turn off afterwards.

live_priority.description: Ask the controller to prefer this plugin while a print is active
